notes.title: V1.05 - Balancing and more
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Well, it's been a busy month - did you see that Kromaia was released on PS4 recently? Very exciting! But, of course, that doesn't mean the PC version doesn't get any love as well, so here's a new update that improves a whole bunch of gameplay elements which will tighten up the Kromaia experience even more…

CHANGE LOG V1.05
[list][*]Portuguese language support - welcome, Portuguese players!
[*]Tau armor locking and firing controls updated
[*]Mu armor laser railgun mechanics
[*]Psi armor automatic stun beam on enemies in range
[*]Score attack achivements updated
[*]Difficulty based scoring
[*]Damage balance updated
[*]Shield item release rate updated
[*]Boss battles adjustments updated
[*]Performance management improved
[*]3D sound management fixed
[*]Clouds and trails transparency fixed
[*]Boss spawn fixed[/list]

As always, please verify your local content to ensure you have the latest version of the game. Enjoy!

notes.title: V1.03 – Online leaderboards (and more)!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

You might have already noticed if you're a Kromaia fan, but there have been a few big updates to the game recently… and now's the time to shout about it!

First up, the big addition: online leaderboards are now live! Since Kromaia is a bullet-hell shooter at heart, this is obviously a major deal and now you can compare your skills to people all around the world. The leaderboards have been separated between Story Mode and Score Attack, the latter of which offers different leaderboards for each armor. Can you hit the top and be the best player ever? There's only one way to find out…

On top of the leaderboards, there have been some vital improvements under the bonnet too:
[list][*]Better collision response, meaning that disorientation after a collision shouldn't be an issue now...
[*]Better unit control, more intuitive and easier for new players (though it's still not that easy – Kromaia is still Kromaia, after all!)
[*]Dual crosshair, with current direction and inertia precalculation for fired projectiles now provided
[*]New boost system for improved control while boosting
[*]Red ship has a new and different primary weapon - it's a controlled railgun. Try it and see how you get on![/list]
As always, please ensure you update your local content to get the latest build of the game. Good luck getting to the top of the leaderboards, everyone!

The RSG / Kraken Empire team

notes.title: Updated - Trading Cards and fixes! (V1.0K)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Kraken Empire have been quietly beavering away since the launch of Kromaia to make it even better, and there's now a new update available that fixes a few features. More importantly though, Trading Cards have now been added to the game! Now you can reap rewards while flying through the cosmos, so there's double the reason to do it!

Here's a rundown of what's changed since V1.0:
[list][*]Trading Cards, badges, emoticons and profile backgrounds added
[*]Fullscreen display now possible for players with multi-monitor configurations
[*]Redefinition is now done on key activation flank
[*]Controls menu visible during tutorial
[*]Controls swap bug fixed
[*]Save point in the last collectible item before boss placed for all but the higher difficulty level
[*]Invulnerability time increased on respawn (to survive some collectible item checkpoints that are protected with traps)
[*]Camera change near planets disabled
[*]“nextra” typo fixed
[*]Emergency exit doors added to some buildings
[*]Saving can’t be disabled from main menu (this option was not intended for players!)
[*]New enemies appear every Halloween!
[/list]
Be sure to update your local content to get the latest version. Have fun!
